source: RIM-ONE DL official repository, hospital-partition variant
source_terms: Research and education use; copying/redistribution prohibited. Aggregate-only reporting; private data, row-level files and checkpoints omitted.

data_audit.source: miag-ull/rim-one-dl official repository; hospital partition variant
data_audit.hospital_partition_means: training hospital(s) versus held-out hospital(s), following source description; not patient-level confirmation
data_audit.terms: Research and education use only; redistribution prohibited per source README. Dataset/images/checkpoint and row-level manifest remain private.

validation_protocol: Seed 8159, stratified image-level 80/20 split within official training hospitals; threshold chosen for >=90% validation sensitivity while maximizing specificity.

source_only_scratch_model.architecture: ResNet-18, random initialization, trained only on RIM-ONE DL hospital training images

pretrained_protocol_deviation.status: exploratory; not the source-only benchmark result
pretrained_protocol_deviation.reason: Source repository requests training/tuning with only RIM-ONE images; this run used external ImageNet pretraining.

test_exposure: The official hospital test was examined in the first run before the source-only rerun. Neither result is an untouched confirmatory evaluation.
interpretation: Neither run met the validation-selected 90% sensitivity target on the hospital partition; each misses glaucoma-positive images. No autonomous, clinical, or deployment claim.
limitations: Patient identifiers absent; patient-level split and patient-cluster uncertainty are unverified.
Data, per-image predictions, manifests and checkpoints remain private under source terms.
